Cyclic simulated direct air capture and desorption on an electrically conductive filter coated with ECCOsorb-1. 1.2.1 Sorbent Synthesis and Coated Filter Manufacturing A joint development agreement (JDA) was executed with an industrial filter manufacturer. The objective of the JDA was to demonstrate the structured sorbent filter can be manufactured using existing filter manufacturing infrastructure, and to demonstrate the structured sorbent filter for DAC with Joule-heated regeneration. To demonstrate the manufacturing feasibility, the industrial partner operated a pilot-scale production line to coat and assemble the structured sorbent filter. As part of this work, Susteon scaled its sorbent synthesis process to produce 50 kg of sorbent, the minimum required to operate the pilot filter manufacturing line.
